bib.title: Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch), Chapter 1: Understanding large language models

question: What is an LLM, how does the transformer/GPT architecture underlie it, and what is the plan for building one from scratch?
contributions: Conceptual overview of LLMs, applications, pretraining vs fine-tuning, transformer, GPT, and a three-stage build plan.

limits: Conceptual chapter with no experiments; GPT-3 figures are secondhand.
Author notes GPT-3 (2020) is old but Llama-style models keep the same concepts with minor modifications.
Author notes the GPT-3 authors did not say why only 300B of 499B tokens were used or share the dataset.
practices: Build an LLM from scratch to understand its mechanics and limitations (1.3).
Train in two stages: pretrain on unlabeled text, then fine-tune on labeled data, via instruction or classification fine-tuning (1.3).
Reuse openly available pretrained weights to skip costly pretraining before fine-tuning (1.5).
Work in three stages: architecture and data prep, pretraining, fine-tuning (1.7, Fig 1.9).
Pretraining in the book is done on a small dataset for education on consumer hardware (1.5, 1.7).
